mapper.select: SELECT provider_item_id FROM teacher_source_sync_manifest WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND document_id = #{documentId} AND item_type IN ('file','docx') AND (logical_path = #{sourcePath} OR local_path = #{sourcePath} OR logical_path = #{pathWithoutExportExtension} OR logical_path LIKE CONCAT('%/', #{sourcePath}) OR logical_path LIKE CONCAT('%/', #{pathWithoutExportExtension}) OR local_path LIKE CONCAT('%/', #{sourcePath}) OR local_path LIKE CONCAT('%/', #{pathWithoutExportExtension})) ORDER BY provider_item_id ASC LIMIT 1
